attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: article_category_matching
steps:
  - id: step_authenticate
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "editorial_pipeline_service"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_fetch_category_spreadsheet
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/integrations/google-drive/category-mapping-spreadsheet"
    output: raw_spreadsheet

  - id: step_validate_spreadsheet
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_spreadsheet
      schema: category_spreadsheet_schema
    output: validated_spreadsheet

  - id: step_read_extracted_article
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: extracted_articles
      filter: "status = 'pending_category'"
    output: raw_article_data

  - id: step_validate_article
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_article_data
      schema: extracted_article_schema
    output: validated_article

  - id: step_extract_article_title
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_article
      field: "title"
    output: article_title

  - id: step_normalise_article_title
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: article_title
      mapping:
        operations:
          - remove_accents: true
          - lowercase: true
          - strip_non_alphanumeric: true
    output: normalised_article_title

  - id: step_normalise_spreadsheet_titles
    op: loop_records
    params:
      collection: validated_spreadsheet
      step_ref: step_normalise_single_spreadsheet_row
    output: normalised_spreadsheet

  - id: step_normalise_single_spreadsheet_row
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_spreadsheet
      mapping:
        operations:
          - field: "title"
          - remove_accents: true
          - lowercase: true
          - strip_non_alphanumeric: true
        preserve_fields: ["category", "section", "original_title"]
    output: normalised_spreadsheet_rows

  - id: step_apply_fuzzy_match
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "fuzzy_title_match"
      input_title: normalised_article_title
      candidates: normalised_spreadsheet_rows
      match_strategy: "accent_insensitive_punctuation_insensitive"
    output: match_result

  - id: step_check_match_found
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "match_result.matched == true"
      true_step: step_extract_matched_category
      false_step: step_apply_default_category

  - id: step_extract_matched_category
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: match_result
      field: "matched_row"
    output: matched_category_data

  - id: step_format_matched_output
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: matched_category_data
      mapping:
        category: "$.category"
        section: "$.section"
        needs_review: false
        article_id: "$.article_id"
    output: category_assignment

  - id: step_route_to_write
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "category_assignment != null"
      true_step: step_write_category_assignment
      false_step: step_terminate

  - id: step_apply_default_category
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_article
      mapping:
        category: "Ciencia economica"
        section: "Dossier"
        needs_review: true
        article_id: "$.id"
    output: category_assignment_default

  - id: step_log_unmatched
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: category_assignment_default
      action: "category_match_failed"
      message: "No fuzzy match found for article title; applying default category and flagging for editorial review"

  - id: step_notify_editorial
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: category_assignment_default
      recipient: "editorial_team"
      template: "unmatched_article_review"
      message: "Article requires manual category review. Default category 'Ciencia economica' / section 'Dossier' applied."

  - id: step_write_category_assignment
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: category_assignment
      table: article_categories
    output: write_result

  - id: step_write_default_category_assignment
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: category_assignment_default
      table: article_categories
    output: write_default_result

  - id: step_terminate
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
      message: "Article category matching workflow finished"
